violated_contract: Every automated Google Play track promotion must commit with changesNotSentForReview=true when automated review submission is disabled. Codemagic's internal-to-alpha promotion creates a separate Play edit commit, so the initial internal-publish hold does not cover it; a post-publish script must also distinguish this build from a duplicate run with the same version and code.
canonical_prevention: Name the internal release with its statically available versioned Codemagic tag and build UUID, promote only that exact completed version/code/run through the Google Play API, preserve unrelated alpha releases, and commit with the shared changesNotSentForReview setting. Keep workflow and API regression tests, and inspect every Play edit commit path.
